claims: The 2026 Men's March Madness First Four was held in Dayton, Ohio on March 17-18.
No. 16 Howard defeated No. 16 UMBC 86-83 on Tuesday in the 2026 First Four.
Howard secured its first-ever NCAA tournament victory.
No. 11 Texas defeated No. 11 NC State 68-66 on Tuesday in the 2026 First Four.
Tramon Mark hit a jumper with 1.1 seconds left to win the Texas vs. NC State game.
No. 16 Prairie View A&M vs. No. 16 Lehigh on Wednesday in the 2026 First Four.
No. 11 Miami (Ohio) vs. No. 11 SMU on Wednesday in the 2026 First Four.
The 2026 First Four was held at UD Arena in Dayton, Ohio.
The 2026 First Four was broadcast on TruTV.
Winners of the 2026 First Four advance to the first round (Round of 64).
